verdict_reasons: Mean SSIM of 0.6995 fell just below the 0.70 gate threshold, correctly zeroing the gated_ssim subscore and the final reward
The agent missed the 3-phase wall-shrinking mechanic entirely, implementing only constant-boundary bouncing, which caused increasing trajectory divergence from the reference
Imprecise hand-tuned velocities and a simplified collision model compounded the frame-by-frame visual mismatch
No anti-cheat gates were triggered; the agent used a genuinely algorithmic approach
The scoring pipeline operated correctly: duration matched perfectly (1.0), but the multiplicative gating with gated_ssim=0.0 properly zeroed the final score
outcome_detail: Agent produced a valid 433-frame video matching reference dimensions and duration, but mean SSIM (0.6995) fell just below the 0.70 gate, yielding gated_ssim=0.0. The agent missed the 3-phase wall-shrinking mechanic and used imprecise velocities, causing progressive trajectory divergence.
strategy: Extract frame positions via Python tracking, build physics sim in Revideo
agent_behavior: Probed reference video metadata (480x360, 24fps, 18s, 433 frames) and extracted frames at both 4fps and 24fps for analysis
Built a Python tracking script to detect 12 colored square centroids across all 433 frames using color-based pixel clustering
Corrected initial color detection (purple, orange, limegreen) by sampling actual pixel values from reference frames
Derived initial velocities by averaging frame-to-frame displacements over the first 5-10 frames, then rounded to nearby integers/half-integers
Implemented a single-phase bouncing simulation with wall reflection and AABB collision response (velocity swap along overlap axis)
Completely missed the 3-phase animation structure: walls shrink inward in phase 2 and partially recover in phase 3
Fixed a timing issue (bare yield vs yield* waitFor(1/FPS)) that initially produced only 348 frames instead of 433
Visually compared output frames against reference frames at several checkpoints but did not iterate further on the physics model
